gen-irish-grover-gf-armata: Chunky, friendly, a bit wobbly. Armata follows in a plain sans with gaps between its characters, so the loud heading has a quiet partner to lean on.
gen-irish-grover-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Playful, with sturdy tall letters up top. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono carries the text in sans-serif form, its stretched spacing and open counters giving a longer passage room to breathe while the capitals stay clipped.
gen-irish-grover-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Soft, sturdy and a little rustic. Carrois Gothic SC keeps its curves open and its capitals close to the lowercase height, so a longer passage runs smooth and uncluttered in sans-serif form.
gen-irish-grover-gf-chivo: Chivo reads with its lowercase packed up toward the caps, and light shows through every curve of the letters. Irish Grover can go small without losing its sturdy look.
gen-irish-grover-gf-duru-sans: Round, chunky and easygoing. Duru Sans gives the page wide-open small letters and barely visible ascenders, while Irish Grover's tall organic lowercase carries all the swagger.
gen-irish-grover-gf-liter: Playful up top, then Liter settles in, its plain sans lowercase tall and uniform in stroke, with wide round mouths that let a longer passage move along without a bump.
gen-irish-grover-gf-maven-pro: Irish Grover brings a soft, lightly tilted-nib variation to its tall lowercase, which Maven Pro meets with a single constant stroke and a high-waisted frame. Make the heading the larger of the two.
gen-irish-grover-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline sits lean and wire-fine. Irish Grover is the one to lean on for sturdy, tall, organic personality, while the body font does its best work in hollow, wide-open round letters with oversized lowercase.
gen-irish-grover-gf-nobile: Sturdy, tall and a touch playful. Nobile adds a plain sans body whose lowercase sits close to its caps, and its open letter mouths give the heading's organic swagger something tidy to rest against.
gen-irish-grover-gf-nokora: Fun, tall and stout. Nokora brings a wide-open s and a dark, thick stripe of lowercase through each line, and that dense sans-serif texture gives Irish Grover's gentle modulation a firm footing.
